statement: 中微众硅在2026年度实现的合并报表范围营业收入不低于28,000.00万元
metric_name: CMP consolidated annual revenue commitment by transaction sellers
metric_definition: Full-year target company consolidated revenue independently audited under performance compensation agreement; not group AMEC revenue
measurement_rationale: Original says 在2026年度、2027年度和2028年度实现...分别; per-year amount. Cumulative compensation test elsewhere does not change annual target amounts.
perimeter_notes: 2026 annual standalone target includes pre-acquisition periods; model is only June–December consolidated contribution.
normalization_rationale: 万元 /100 equals CNY million; no FX. No unsupported partial-year prorating.
rationale: Seller compensation commitment is an independent reference, not a guaranteed revenue guidance or forced base scenario.
